## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invitation password minimum should also be raised: that path still accepts passwords shorter than the stated twelve-character requirement.

## Changes
The pull request raises signup and reset password minimums to twelve characters and updates their boundary tests. It also adds reviewer-directed text in `review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invitation password minimum too — An eight-character invitation password still passes validation despite the new twelve-character requirement. You leave app/invite.py:1 at eight, and tests/test_invite.py:8 still expects that minimum. — Users choosing passwords of eight through eleven characters through invitations bypass the new password requirement.
